alerte.texte: Seven pull requests merged: two Hick's law changes, your private profile point, and four CI and test fixes. Your choices are in: the still map panel is pushed, and the composer's scrolling is approved.

depuis.texte: Team only: first step of a performance patrol, a measurement chain marked advisory.
Team only: an observability console, with its screens and a browser SDK for the website and the console.
Private profile: a locked profile now shows Friends, Takes and Score. Your TestFlight point.
Hick's law point 12: in search, « Sort by » stays only on the Top tab; Latest, Photos and Videos keep Date and From.
Hick's law point 3: the sign-in sheet has no cross any more, only « Later » and a swipe down.
CI: the picture check of pull requests no longer takes a bot's logo for a screenshot; only real pictures count.
CI: the app's page names are finally type-checked, so a link to a page that does not exist can no longer pass.
Server: checks of curated videos no longer call the video sites in bursts after a delay; they stay 50 ms apart.
Test loop: the development seed now writes everything the regression loop needs, so no more manual catch-up after each seed.
CI only: the nightly route sweep may now write its tracking tickets.
Messages: a thread opened from a notification now goes back to your inbox with Back, like X and Instagram.
Messages: tapping the Messages tab from inside a thread always lands on your inbox, clearing the threads opened on top.
Website: documents always show in the chosen language, and the welcome page is no longer fetched ahead of time.
A lint rule now blocks the two ways of opening a page that skipped the double-tap guard. Found by the Hick's law audit.
Every pull request that changes the app must now show it breaks nothing (its regression study), or a check fails. Your request of 10/10.
Profile song chip and picker on mobile and web

On the map search, picking a suggestion writes its name in the bar, ready to be written over; the places follow the typing sooner and the flight takes 1.2 s instead of 2.4. Your TestFlight point; for the next build.

Messages and the Profile are prepared ahead while you rest on Amis, switched off by default. Measured on a cloud iPhone: off, it costs nothing; on, it slows nothing and makes launch lighter (12 network reads instead of 22). For the next build.
An official Take's video is removed only when the video site says it is gone twice, a day apart; one passing error no longer removes it for good. It reaches staging with the next server deploy.

claude.libelle: A Claude is fixing it here

enCours.sujet: Hick's law: the five changes left of the seven you accepted
enCours.ouEnEst: Two are merged (no cross on the sign-in sheet, sorting only on Top). Left: mentions in the most likely order (two pictures to redo, to prove an anonymous author never moves), the welcome screen, the map's single arrow, and the composer's « No limit » and single sound button. All are reviewed and green; they wait for their pictures.

enCours.sujet: Hick's law: your choice for points 1, 2, 6 and 7
enCours.ouEnEst: The page shows 15 options for the four points you want redone. You said you will tell me later.
enCours.reste: Your choice, then a Claude builds it.

enCours.sujet: Map search: suggestions follow every letter, with the still panel
enCours.ouEnEst: You chose the still panel: while you type, the panel takes the full height above the keyboard and the field no longer jumps. It is pushed, and the 184 tests of the map pass.
enCours.reste: Pictures in light and dark, a review, then merge.

enCours.ouEnEst: Taken over by a Claude on the Mac: no fade on the panel, the list follows every letter, and a lookup is skipped when the previous answer is already complete, so the people-search quota is not used up. Reviewed, CI green.
enCours.reste: Merge right after the mention ranking.

enCours.sujet: Explore pages going blank during quick changes
enCours.ouEnEst: The missing test is written and reviewed; CI is green.
enCours.reste: Pictures and a measurement on a device, then your OK.

enCours.ouEnEst: Found: in bounded mode, rows lose and get back their pictures while you scroll; a two-line fix removes it during the gesture. On the Mac's simulator, bounded mode is even 0.6 s smoother. The Release measurement stopped to save the disk.
enCours.reste: Release measurement later; not in build 197, as you decided.

enCours.ouEnEst: Merged tonight: page names checked, real pictures only, the seed, the video checks. In review: a security check that could skip a new secret because of its cache (#4843), six flaky tests fixed at their cause, the seed without cloud storage that broke the Takes tab on the Mac (#4844), and a test-loop step for Back from a notification.

enCours.sujet: Taps lost when two arrive within one frame
enCours.ouEnEst: Two fingers overlapping on the same button count once, which is React Native's normal touch model; taps apart, even barely, both count.

equipe: Here on the Mac: me, six Claude agents (reviews, test fixes, the seed, mentions), audit-hick taking the composer pictures and measurement, and your emulator on staging.
On Replicas, on Muse Spark through OpenCode: wombat takes the remaining pictures on a cloud iPhone; fouine is down (its OpenCode answers error 400). Claude is still out on Replicas.
etapes: Pictures, then merge: map search, composer, mentions, welcome screen, map arrow.
Mentions: merge right after the mention ranking.
Hick's law points 1, 2, 6 and 7: when you choose.
Then the full regression loop on the exact build-197 commit, and your OK.
